tooltips.forgermod.ability.flaming_combo: Flaming Combo: For 10 seconds, each dagger hit adds 1 second of burn (30-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.pyromaniac: Pyromaniac: While burning, arm your next dagger hit to ignite the target for 5 seconds and heal 5 HP (50-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.void_step: Stepping Through the Void: Teleport up to 10 blocks in your look direction, including into the air; up to 20 blocks with another Riftfang Dagger in your offhand (7-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sudden_presen: Sudden Presence: Teleport behind the nearest hostile mob within 20 blocks (2-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.ability.unavailable: Ability cannot be used right now
tooltips.forgermod.ability.absolute_nigh: Absolute Nightmare: Your next 2 dagger hits inflict Darkness I and Weakness I for 10 seconds (20-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.lucid_dreamin: Lucid Dreaming: Your next hit against an enemy grants Speed II and halves fall damage for 5 seconds (15-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.lucid.armed: Lucid Dreaming armed for your next hit
tooltips.forgermod.ability.area_discharg: Area Discharge: Strike hostile mobs within 5 blocks with lightning for 5 damage each (5-minute cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.charge_attack: Charge Attack: Your next 20 mob hits build charge; the 21st deals 20 extra lightning damage (2-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.charge_attack.armed: Charge Attack armed for 21 mob hits
tooltips.forgermod.passive.chain_lightni: Chain Lightning: Dagger hits arc to up to 2 other hostile mobs within 10 blocks of the target for 5 damage each
tooltips.forgermod.ability.eye_of_the_st: Eye of the Storm: Whirl and levitate hostile mobs within 10 blocks for 5 seconds (1-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.eye_of_the_storm.activ: Eye of the Storm active for 5 seconds
tooltips.forgermod.ability.windy_dash: Windy Dash: Burst up to 6 blocks forward over a short dash (5-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.passive.double_jump: Double Jump: Press Jump again in midair after a normal jump to leap once more
tooltips.forgermod.ability.deep_wound: Deep Wound: Your next critical dagger hit deals double damage and inflicts Slowness I for 2 seconds (30-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.deep_wound.armed: Deep Wound armed for your next critical hit
tooltips.forgermod.ability.leech: Leech: Your next 10 dagger hits drain up to 10% of the target's maximum health each and heal you by the health drained (15-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.rooting_roots: Rooting Roots: Hold hostile mobs within 5 blocks in place and poison them for 10 seconds (1-minute cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.poisoned_vein: Poisoned Vein: Your next dagger kill against a hostile mob leaves a 3-block poison cloud for 5 seconds, applying 30 seconds of Poison I to anyone inside, including you (45-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.poisoned_vein.armed: Poisoned Vein armed for your next hostile kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.strengthened_: Strengthened Bones: Your next dagger kill against a hostile mob makes you invulnerable for 10 seconds (90-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.strengthened_bones.arm: Strengthened Bones armed for your next hostile kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.storing_anger: Storing Anger: Deal no damage for 10 seconds; your next Morsium dagger hit releases all stored damage (1-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.storing_anger.active: Storing Anger: damage is stored for 10 seconds
tooltips.forgermod.passive.death_march: Death March: Dagger damage rises as the target loses health, up to double damage
tooltips.forgermod.passive.revenge: Revenge: Deal 20% more dagger damage to undead mobs
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sonic_crit: Sonically Charged Crit: Your next critical dagger hit adds damage equal to 15% of the target's maximum health and releases a sonic boom (30-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.sonic_crit.armed: Sonically Charged Crit armed for your next critical hit
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sonic_boom: Sonic Boom: Fire a 50-block piercing sonic blast along your aim, dealing twice your equipped attack damage to every enemy in its path; blocks stop the blast (45-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.passive.axe:
§7
Passive: Every third attack within 10 seconds slams a 3×3 area ahead.
Requires an empty offhand.§r
tooltips.forgermod.passive.dagger:
§7
Passive: Matching daggers strike in both hands; special daggers apply their material effect on hit.§r
tooltips.forgermod.axe.tooltip:
§7A heavy carbon steel head balanced for
hard, deliberate strikes.

Passive: Every third attack within 10 seconds slams a 3×3 area ahead.
Requires an empty offhand.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_axe.tooltip:
§7Its edge has flaked away beneath years
of rust. Old forge marks remain on the
haft.

Can be restored.

Passive: Every third attack within 10 seconds slams a 3×3 area ahead.
Requires an empty offhand.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_dagger.tooltip:
§7A small blade dulled by rust. It once
belonged to someone who travelled light.

Can be restored.

Passive: Matching daggers strike in both hands.§r
tooltips.forgermod.verdant_axe.tooltip:
§7Roots from a Lush Cave wrap around
this axe, gripping its head as firmly
as any smith's binding.§r
tooltips.forgermod.ghost_axe.tooltip:
§7Bone and iron from the Soul Sand
Valleys form an axe that feels lighter
than it has any right to be.§r
tooltips.forgermod.molten_axe.tooltip:
§7Forged beside the lava seas of the
Nether, this axe still carries the heat
of its first fire.§r
tooltips.forgermod.nullified_axe.tooltip:
§7An axe shaped in the End's cold void.
Light seems to fade along its edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.woundmaker_axe.toolti:
§7Crystallized blood from the undead
runs through its head. Old stains
never leave the blade.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dreamweaver_axe.toolt:
§7An axe imagined into being in a dream.
Its outline shifts whenever you look away.§r
tooltips.forgermod.echoing_axe.tooltip:
§7Sculk from the deepest dark lines this
axe. Every blow leaves a faint echo
in the silence.§r
tooltips.forgermod.voltage_axe.tooltip:
§7A lightning strike charged its
Electrium head. Sparks gather where
the blade meets the haft.§r
tooltips.forgermod.skybreaker_axe.toolti:
§7Refined by storms at great heights,
its Taifunite head cuts through the
air with a restless whistle.§r
tooltips.forgermod.leafcutter_dagger.too:
§7A slim blade threaded with Lush Cave
vines. Its edge parts leaves without
slowing the hand that holds it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.deathwisper_dagger.to:
§7Bone remnants from the Soul Sand
Valleys give this pale dagger an
unsettling, whisper-quiet edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.emberfang_dagger.tool:
§7A short Nether-forged blade that
still glows like an ember beneath
its darkened surface.§r
tooltips.forgermod.riftfang_dagger.toolt:
§7A sliver of the End's void shaped into
a dagger. Its edge seems to end beyond
where you can see it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.assassin_dagger.toolt:
§7Undead blood has crystallized along
this narrow blade. Its dark red edge
is made for a quick, close strike.§r
tooltips.forgermod.nightmare_dagger.tool:
§7A dagger born from a troubled dream.
Even awake, its shape is difficult
to remember clearly.§r
tooltips.forgermod.wardens_needle.toolti:
§7A sculk-tipped needle from the deepest
dark. Its narrow point is almost lost
against the shadows around it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.static_dagger.tooltip:
§7Lightning left a restless charge in
this small Electrium blade. Tiny
sparks dance along its edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dead_calm_dagger.tool:
§7A Taifunite dagger honed by high
winds. The air goes strangely still
just before it moves.§r
tooltips.forgermod.gemstone_upgrade_temp:
§7This template is used to infuse weapons
with gemstones increasing specific weapon stats.

Infuse your weapons at the Infusion Table!§r
tooltips.forgermod.ancient_upgrade_templ:
§7This template is used to forge advanced
weapons like claymores.

Forge weapons in the Forge!§r
tooltips.forgermod.claymore.tooltip:
§7A long Sword made from the best
Materials you found on your adventures.

Can be upgraded with every
§r§dsupreme Material.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_claymore.toolti:
§7It looks like a claymore, but it's
extremely rusty, it barely even cuts
through grass. It must have been forged
hundreds of years ago.

Can be restored.§r
tooltips.forgermod.infernal_claymore.too:
§7A blazing claymore usually found in
ancient nether structures, made by
the ancients.

Effect on hit: Glowing I for 100 Seconds§r
§7A dark and cool-looking claymore usually
found in the end, deep in the void.

Effect on hit: Blindness I for 4 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.overgrown_claymore.to:
§7A very old claymore which must have
been in a lush cave for a very long
time.

Effect on hit: Hunger III for 10 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.hollow_claymore.toolt:
§7A claymore reinforced by bones from
the enemies it killed. A truly scary
sword to possess.

Effect on hit: Weakness III for 5 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.curseblood_claymore.t:
§7A bloody claymore cursed by all the
enemies it defeated. It's being said
that it belonged to a psychopath long
ago.

Effect on hit: Wither II for 4 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.dreambound_claymore.t:
§7A claymore sending enemies to eternal
rest. A claymore known as deadly as
death itself, and often used for killing
people while they are asleep.

Effect on hit: Nausea IV for 10 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.shrieking_claymore.to:
§7A claymore found in the deepest depths,
reinforced with sculk, a material
from another dimension.

Effect on hit: Darkness V for 7 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.claymore_of_thunder.t:
§7A claymore charged by the might of
lightning, 1,000,000 volts of electricity
flow through this blade electrifying
everyone coming too close.

Effect on hit: Slowness III for 5 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.storming_claymore.too:
§7A claymore found at high altitudes, due
to the high wind speeds blowing everything
away.

Effect on hit: Levitation II for 3 Seconds§r§r
tooltips.forgermod.inanisium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material found in the void,
where nothing else is able to exist.§r
tooltips.forgermod.ignisium_ingot.toolti:
§7A supreme material found deep in the
nether, mostly submerged in lava
and magma.§r
tooltips.forgermod.pulsite_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found in the deepest
depths, in a very dark environment.§r
tooltips.forgermod.somnium_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material that can only be
imagined. It may appear in your 
dreams.§r
tooltips.forgermod.vulnusium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material found deep in the flesh of undead monsters, where blood
crystallizes to a very strong material.§r
tooltips.forgermod.morsium_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found deep in the
Soulsand Valleys, mostly under a pile
of bones and remnants.§r
tooltips.forgermod.lush_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found mostly in
Lush Caves, where plants are 
thriving, and new live emerges.§r
tooltips.forgermod.electrium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material charged up by a
highly energized lightning strike, it 
is said that it's the secret behind the creeper's
ability to charge up.§r
tooltips.forgermod.taifunite_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material refined by endless storms and
strong winds blowing on high
altitudes.§r
tooltips.forgermod.developium_ingot.tool:
§7A supreme material made up by the
genius (BananasHelp20), who made the
mod, in cooperation with
ALLESBANANE11§r

§dCreative only!§r
tooltips.forgermod.carbon_steel_cross_gu:
§7A good sword needs a cross guard,
protecting the owner from hits of
enemies.§r
tooltips.forgermod.sharpened_blade.toolt:
§7A blade sharpened till all of the
fingers bleed, the smith of this
blade must have been extremely
focused on sharpening the blade.§r
tooltips.forgermod.handle.tooltip:
§7This handle is used for more advanced
weapons, than the regular ones.
It's very stable and way harder
than a simple stick.§r
tooltips.forgermod.advanced_handle.toolt:
§7This handle is used for the best
weapons imaginable, extremely stable,
and very comfortable to hold.§r
tooltips.forgermod.amethyst.tooltip:
§7A very dense and fine variant of the
amethyst found in geodes, it's absolutely
flawless.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§5+4 Attack Speed§r
tooltips.forgermod.amber.tooltip:
§7It burns your finger upon touching it.
It's a flawless, yet extremely hot stone
and you've never seen something like it
before.

When applied to a Weapon:
§r§6makes item fire resistant§r
tooltips.forgermod.ruby.tooltip:
§7A sharp and edgy stone. It's shining
as red as the blood your enemies
bleed when killed with a very sharp
weapon.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§4+1 Damage§r
tooltips.forgermod.jade.tooltip:
§7A very precious jewel, which gives you
the feeling that it could bring up the true
potential of any supreme weapon.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§2+1 Effect Amplifier
+1 Second Effect Duration§r
